definition.efficiency: sum_i P(i pivotal)=1 for every nontrivial target
definition.pivotal_count_formula: p_H(i,k)=#{A:|A|=k,i in A, hit_H(A), not hit_H(A\{i})}(k-1)!(16-k)!
definition.pivotal_event: label i is last at the first prefix that hits H
definition.random_object: uniform permutation of the sixteen C75 named labels
